items.prompt: Each new commit in a simple linear history…
choices: Points at its parent and adds a new snapshot
Only exists in the browser lab
items.explain: A commit records staged content and links to the previous commit as its parent.

items.prompt: git log --oneline is useful because it…
choices: Shows a compact list of recent commits
items.explain: One line per commit (short hash + message) helps you read history quickly.

items.prompt: You must run git add before git commit when you want to record file changes.
items.explain: Commit records what is staged; unstaged edits stay only in the working tree.

items.prompt: The git-graph browser lab mainly helps you…
choices: Practice staging, committing, and seeing the graph grow
items.explain: The lab is a literacy playground for the same moves you repeat on real Git.
